integrity: General proof establishes the natural filtered PL homeomorphism for all n>=3, d dividing n and real r>=0; standalone bounded enumeration is corroborative, not an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Only inclusive shortest-cycle graph metric on evenly spaced cyclic vertex sets; only rotational subgroups and geometric fixed points; not arbitrary metric polygons, reflective fixed sets, orbit quotients, or homotopy fixed points. Priority against unindexed equivalent results remains uncertain.
title: Cyclic-subgroup fixed-point persistence of polygonal Vietoris–Rips complexes
